verdict.rationale: Firstbase documents a compliance dashboard giving an instant overview of the company's status in each state, with click-through to requirements, upcoming deadlines and actions (docs-6, docs-8). It also tracks all compliance requirements and deadlines and files annual and franchise tax reports (docs-7). Evidence covers one company across its states, not a portfolio view of multiple entities, and all of it is vendor marketing. missing for 10: evidence of a single view across multiple entities, detail on how good-standing status is shown, independent or hands-on corroboration of the dashboard.
